title: Eigenvalues & Eigenvectors
description: Visualizes eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the 2×2 matrix [[2,1],[1,2]]. A NumberPlane grid is drawn with three vectors: v1 = (1,1) in yellow, v2 = (-1,1) in red, and v3 = (1,0) in green. The matrix transformation is applied to the grid and vectors simultaneously — v1 scales by eigenvalue 3, v2 stays at eigenvalue 1, and v3 gets rotated. Labels highlight which vectors are eigenvectors.
key_objects: Vector v1 (1,1) — yellow, eigenvector with eigenvalue 3
Vector v2 (-1,1) — red, eigenvector with eigenvalue 1
what_to_modify: Try a different matrix (e.g. [[3,1],[0,2]]), change vector colors, add eigenvalue labels with numeric values, animate vectors individually, or show the characteristic equation.
